evidence.quote: Give reef managers direct, repeatable observations of coral colour over the whole Great Barrier Reef
Its customers are the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority, which needs up-to-date bleaching maps

criteria.reasoning: Clear goal, four quantified objectives, users (AIMS, GBRMPA, CSIRO, BoM) tied to needs, and literature cited [1]-[6]. Objectives explicitly traced to user needs. Minor gap: no explicit requirements table/verification, but essentially complete.

evidence.quote: Project work is divided into weeks in the Gantt chart in Figure 1
The main risks and the planned responses are listed in Table 1.

criteria.reasoning: Gantt chart with task descriptions, explicit logic linking plan order to mission (orbit before comms), contingencies/risk table, float, and a planned-sources table (Table 2) including SMAD and lecture notes. Robust and mission-aligned.

evidence.quote: Weekly coverage (objective 1) is therefore not guaranteed by one satellite at this altitude and resolution.

criteria.reasoning: Hand calculations verified correct (a=6978 km, T=5801 s, 14.9 orbits/day, i≈97.8° SSO, 24.2° track shift). Results interpreted against objectives, swath trade identified, STK tutorials done and scenario set up. On track.

criteria.reasoning: Logical structure, clear writing, labelled figures/tables, consistent IEEE-style citations matching the reference list, colour legend explained. Very professional presentation.

technical_issues.issue: Ground-track shift quoted at the equator is fine, but the reef sits at ~18-20°S where track spacing is smaller; the coverage conclusion is conservative but could note latitude dependence.
10 m GSD at 600 km implies a demanding telescope/aperture; feasibility not yet addressed (acceptable at this stage).

overall: Excellent preliminary report: well-justified Australian reef-monitoring mission, quantified objectives, robust Gantt plan with contingencies, correct hand calculations with interpretation, and polished presentation. Minor refinements to coverage analysis would strengthen it.
